title: Page 2
content_zh:
向家在景安城是有点名气的古董商，原本生意也是不错的，只可惜出了差池，如今已卸匾关店。

「可是丽平她……」向夫人不放心地看着女儿，咬了咬唇。

陆诗妍也是迷惘又困惑地望着两人，她很努力的想理解他们的话，却仍旧一头雾水。

咱们向家？这两夫妇姓向？他们是谁？为什么跟她说话时的语气，像是……像是爹娘对女儿说话般？她爹娘呢？究竟发生了什么事？

「你……你们是谁？」陆诗妍努力让咬字更清楚一些。

两人一怔，瞪大眼睛的瞅着她。

「我们是谁？！丽平，你这是怎么了？」向夫人惊慌的抓住女儿的手，哭道：「闺女啊，你是真疯还是卖傻？别吓娘啊！」

「闺女？」陆诗妍秀眉一拧，满腹疑惑地看着向夫人。

这时，她的眼角余光瞥见房里另一侧的镜台，镜子映照出一张她从不曾见过的面孔，她的心猛地一惊。

「我……是谁？」她瞪大眼睛问着眼前的这对夫妇，「我是谁？！」

「你……」向夫人先是一顿，然后满脸忧愁地道：「你是向丽平，我们的亲闺女呀！」

不不不，她是陆诗妍，安阳陆家的陆诗妍！

突地，她感到一阵晕眩，再度失去了意识。

此时，陆诗妍以向丽平的身分，押着由一头骡子拉着、堆满各式值钱或不值钱的古董的板车，跟老管家费管家前往城里新开不久的「万宝斋」。

她怎么都想不到自己出事后，魂魄竟会附到向丽平身上，从此有了全新的人生及开始。

她不是没想过回到陆家，可她能拿什么理由离开，说出事实不是被当疯了，就是被当妖物，而且徒增向家夫妇的伤心……如此一想她回去的心思就压抑住了，也不敢提起这种离奇的事。

向家本在景安城从事古董买卖，向老爷一时贪心不察，收购了一批来路不明的古董，原以为捡到了便宜，却没想到这些古董中有几件是等级极差的淘汰劣品，其余的都是作工还算精细的赝品，不细看还真看不出来。

古董售出后，客人发现买到了劣品及赝品，气得上门理论，此事外扬，向家古董店声誉受损，一夕之间便垮了。

为了清偿部分货款，向家遣散了家里的伙计及仆婢，可是这样仍是不够，只好收了金老板的聘金，就是因为这样，向丽平必须被迫嫁给年已六十的金老板做小，才会一时想不开而上吊求死。

她便是听闻向家古董店要贱卖古董，才会从安阳城出发来到这儿，未料中途发生意外，没了性命，魂魄仍寻到了这儿来，还上了向丽平的身。

她想，这是天意吧！

向丽平原本死了，可是她附了向丽平的身，向丽平又活了，她的命运已然改变，而她也即将改变向丽平的人生，她绝不嫁金老板，她还要把向氏古董店的招牌重新扛起来。

为了周转变现，向家必须先将一些真品卖掉，结清债务，才能再慢慢去收购一些古董买卖，从中获取价差。

她想，以她在古董监别上的卓越能力，一定能让向家东山再起。

思忖着，他们已经来到万宝斋。

万宝斋位在景安城大街最热闹的一段，三间门面的大店铺，朱红色大门，气派体面。

费管家说万宝斋的店东来自淮城，是富可敌国的巨贾，在景安城开业月余，据说月营收已近两万两银，财力惊人。

「费管家，咱们先进去打个照面。」说完，她请万宝斋门口的伙计帮她看着板车，便领着费管家走了进去。

店内人声鼎沸，各个朝奉柜台前都有典当卖物的客人，还有不少客人坐在边上候着，伙计们正热络的端茶送水，又有一些好事好奇的客人凑在柜台前欣赏着别人家的物件，顺道品头论足一番。

她不知找谁说话，只得随便挑了一个柜台凑了过去。

柜台后方坐着一名年约二十多的年轻朝奉，正拿着一名客人拿来卖的瓷瓶，翻来倒去的端详着。

监定古瓷器主要从款式、造型、纹饰和胎釉特征方面下手，根据款式来确定瓷器新旧及真伪，是监别工作中重要的一个环节。

那客人一脸小心翼翼地道：「我这瓷瓶可是大朝康平年间的官窑所出，你给瞧瞧那上面的花鸟字体，可都是少见的精致呀！」

那年轻朝奉看了看，点点头道：「确实精致华美……」

「你可得给个好价钱，这瓷瓶已有两百年历史，可是我家的传家宝，要不是有急需，是打死都不卖的。」客人说道。

「唔……」年轻朝奉思索着，有点疑虑，「贵客请等等，我请大掌柜过来过个眼。」

客人脸色一沉。「若你们不要这瓷瓶，我可拿到大街另一头的九珍轩去了。」

「这……」年轻朝奉一听，有点慌了。

陆诗妍在一旁看着，那瓷瓶上头的花鸟字体确实精美，横、竖、撇、捺、勾、挑、点等的特征俱全，釉色也十分鲜艳华美，不过当那年轻朝奉将瓶倒过来之时，她注意到这瓷瓶圈足属于宽幅，这就表示瓷瓶并非大朝康平年间所出。

于是，她走上前，问道：「可以让我过个眼吗？」

朝奉愣了一下，男人也愣住。

「姑娘，你是……」

「家父正想找一只大朝康平年间的瓷器

年轻朝奉看着那前来典当的客人，问道：「爷，你说好吗？」

客人瞧了她一眼，点点头道：「也好，万宝斋不收，我卖别人也行。」

有了客人的同意，年轻朝奉便将瓷瓶小心翼翼的递出。

陆诗妍小心反覆地确认，思索时，不自觉伸出右手食指搓弄着微微纠结的眉心。

须臾，她确认了自己方才的初判。

「这只瓷瓶并非大朝康平年间的官窑所出。」她笃定地道。

此话一出，客人及年轻朝奉都愣住了。

「你……」客人不悦地看着她。「你是谁？凭什么说我的瓷瓶不是大朝康平年间所出？」

她沉静一笑。「大朝康平年间官窑所出的瓷器，圈足属于窄幅，底心内凹，器身薄透，也因此保存不易，多有毁损。」

听到她这么一解释，年轻朝奉不禁露出惊讶表情。

「物以稀为贵。」陆诗妍续道：「因为罕有，这些瓷器全都进了宫中，难以外流。」

「你这是说我的瓷瓶是假货？」客人愤怒地质问道。

「不。」她道，「依我看，这瓶确实是官窑所出，但这形制属于新朝的物件，不过二十来年的时间，数量极多，常用来打赏文武百官，但一般来说只是寻常日常物件，并非可供

年轻朝奉一惊。「姑娘，你说的是真的吗？」

「不假。」陆诗妍很有自信地道，「若不信，可请贵宝号的其他朝奉或大掌柜前来监别。」

那客人听见她这么说，一把将瓷瓶抢回来，气冲冲地道：「哼！我不卖了！臭丫头，你给我记着！」他将瓷瓶收入盒中，旋身离去。

离去之时，那人差点儿撞上费管家，费管家看了他一眼，露出疑惑的神情，那人瞥了他一眼，眼神有点闪烁。

费管家皱起眉头，仍在思索着什么，可那人已迈开步子，飞也似的离开了。

年轻朝奉想起自己差点高估买价，不禁松了一口气，抱拳一揖。「姑娘及时指正，康宁在此谢过。」

「好说。」陆诗妍点头一笑。「区区小事，不足挂齿。」
content_en:
The Xiang family is a well-known antique dealer in Jing'an City. The business was originally good, but unfortunately something went wrong and now the store has been closed.

"But Liping..." Mrs. Xiang looked at her daughter worriedly and bit her lip.

Lu Shiyan also looked at the two people in confusion and confusion. She tried very hard to understand what they said, but she was still confused.

Shall we go home?The last name of these two couples is Xiang?who are they?Why does the tone when talking to her sound like... like a father and mother talking to their daughter?Where are her parents?What happened?

"You...who are you?" Lu Shiyan tried to speak more clearly.

The two of them were startled and stared at her with wide eyes.

"Who are we?! Liping, what's wrong with you?" Mrs. Xiang grabbed her daughter's hand in panic and cried, "My daughter, are you really crazy or are you stupid? Don't scare me!"

"Daughter?" Lu Shiyan frowned and looked at Mrs. Xiang with doubts.

At this moment, she caught a glimpse of the mirror on the other side of the room from the corner of her eye. The mirror reflected a face she had never seen before, and her heart was suddenly shocked.

"Who am I?" She asked the couple in front of her with wide eyes, "Who am I?!"

"You..." Mrs. Xiang paused for a moment, then said with a sad face: "You are Xiang Liping, our daughter!"

No, no, no, she is Lu Shiyan, Lu Shiyan from the Lu family in Anyang!

Suddenly, she felt dizzy and lost consciousness again.

At this time, Lu Shiyan, in the identity of Xiang Liping, escorted a cart pulled by a mule and piled with various valuable and worthless antiques, and went with the old butler Fei Guanjia to the newly opened "Wanbaozhai" in the city.

She never imagined that after her accident, her soul would possess Xiang Liping, and she would have a new life and start from then on.

It's not that she has never thought about returning to the Lu family, but what reason can she give to leave? If she tells the truth, she will either be regarded as crazy or treated as a monster, and it will only increase the sadness of the Xiang family and his wife... The thought of her going back suppressed her thoughts, and she did not dare to mention such bizarre things.

Xiang Jiaben was engaged in the antique business in Jing'an City. Mr. Xiang was greedy and purchased a batch of antiques with unknown origins. He thought he was getting a bargain, but he didn't expect that some of these antiques were extremely low-grade discarded and inferior products. The rest were fakes with relatively fine workmanship. You couldn't tell without looking carefully.

After the antiques were sold, the customer found out that he had bought inferior and fake items, and was so angry that he came to argue. This matter became public, and the reputation of Xiangjia Antiques Store was damaged, and it collapsed overnight.

In order to pay off part of the payment, Xiang's family dismissed the family's clerks and maids, but this was still not enough, so they had to accept boss Jin's dowry. Because of this, Xiang Liping had to be forced to marry the sixty-year-old boss Jin as a child, so she hanged herself and begged to die.

She set out from Anyang City to come here because she heard that Xiang's Antique Shop was selling antiques at a low price. Unexpectedly, an accident happened on the way and she lost her life. Her soul still found its way here and even took up Xiang Liping's body.

She thought, this is God's will!

Xiang Liping was originally dead, but she possessed Xiang Liping's body, and Xiang Liping came back to life. Her destiny has changed, and she is about to change Xiang Liping's life. She will never marry Boss Jin, and she will also carry the sign of Xiang's antique shop again.

In order to turn over cash, Xiangjia must first sell some genuine items and pay off his debts before slowly acquiring some antiques to obtain the price difference.

She thought that with her outstanding ability in antique inspection, she would definitely be able to make a comeback for the Xiang family.

Thinking about it, they have arrived at Wanbaozhai.

Wanbaozhai is located in the busiest section of Jing'an City Street. It is a large shop with three facades and a vermilion door, which is elegant and dignified.

Butler Fei said that the owner of Wanbaozhai came from Huaicheng and was an extremely wealthy businessman. He had been operating in Jing'an City for only a month, and his monthly revenue was said to be nearly 20,000 taels of silver, which was an astonishing amount of money.

"Steward Fei, let's go in and see each other first." After saying that, she asked the guy at the entrance of Wanbaozhai to help her look at the cart, and then led Butler Fei inside.

The store was bustling with people, and there were customers pawning and selling items in front of each counter. There were also many customers sitting on the side waiting for them. The clerks were serving tea and water enthusiastically, and some curious customers gathered in front of the counter to admire other people's items and comment on them.

She didn't know who to talk to, so she just picked a counter and walked over.

Behind the counter sat a young court official in his twenties, holding a porcelain vase that a customer brought to sell, turning it over and over and looking at it.

The appraisal of ancient porcelain mainly starts from the aspects of style, shape, decoration and glaze characteristics. Determining the newness and authenticity of the porcelain based on the style is an important step in the appraisal work.

The guest said cautiously: "This porcelain vase of mine came from the official kiln during the Kangping period of the Great Dynasty. Take a look at the flower and bird fonts on it. They are all rare and delicate!"

The young Chao Feng looked at it, nodded and said, "It is indeed exquisite and gorgeous..."

"You have to give me a good price. This porcelain vase is two hundred years old, but if it wasn't for the urgent need, I wouldn't sell it to my heirloom," the guest said.

"Well..." Young Chaofeng thought, a little doubtful, "Dear guest, please wait a moment. I'll ask the shopkeeper to come over and pay a visit."

The guest's face darkened."If you don't want this porcelain vase, I can take it to Jiuzhenxuan on the other side of the street."

"This..." Young Chaofeng was a little panicked when he heard this.

Lu Shiyan looked at it from the side. The flower and bird fonts on the porcelain vase were indeed exquisite. They had all the characteristics of horizontal, vertical, left, back, hook, pick, and dot. The glaze color was also very bright and gorgeous. However, when the young court turned the vase upside down, she noticed that the circle of the porcelain vase was quite wide, which meant that the porcelain vase was not produced during the Kangping period of the great dynasty.

So, she stepped forward and asked, "Can you let me have a look?"

Chao Feng was stunned for a moment, and so was the man.

"Girl, you are..."

"My father is looking for a porcelain from the Kangping period of the Great Dynasty.

The young Chaofeng looked at the guest who came to pawn and asked, "Sir, do you agree?"

The customer glanced at her, nodded and said, "That's fine. If Wanbaozhai doesn't accept it, I can sell it to someone else."

With the guest's consent, the young court official handed over the porcelain bottle carefully.

Lu Shiyan confirmed carefully and repeatedly. While thinking, she unconsciously stretched out her right index finger to rub the slightly tangled eyebrows.

After a moment, she confirmed her initial judgment.

"This porcelain vase is not from the official kiln during the Kangping period of the Great Dynasty." She said firmly.

As soon as these words came out, the guests and the young court officials were stunned.

"You..." The guest looked at her displeased."Who are you? Why do you say that my porcelain vase was not made during the Kangping period of the Great Dynasty?"

She smiled quietly."The porcelain produced by the official kilns during the Kangping period of the Great Dynasty has a narrow circle, a concave bottom, and a thin body. Therefore, it is not easy to preserve and many of them are damaged."

Hearing her explanation, the young Chaofeng couldn't help but show a surprised expression.

"Things are rare and valuable." Lu Shiyan continued: "Because they are rare, all these porcelains have been brought into the palace and are difficult to escape."

"Are you saying that my porcelain bottle is fake?" the customer asked angrily.

"No." She said, "In my opinion, this vase is indeed from the official kiln, but its shape belongs to the New Dynasty. However, it has been produced in large quantities for more than twenty years. It is often used to reward civil and military officials, but generally speaking, it is just an ordinary daily object and is not available for use.

The young Chao Feng was shocked."Girl, are you telling the truth?"

"It's true." Lu Shiyan said confidently, "If you don't believe it, you can ask other court officials or the chief storekeeper of Guibao to come and say goodbye."

When the customer heard what she said, he snatched the porcelain vase back and said angrily: "Huh! I won't sell it anymore! You stinky girl, remember this!" He put the porcelain vase into the box and turned away.

When leaving, the man almost bumped into Butler Fei. Butler glanced at him with a puzzled expression, and the man glanced at him, his eyes twinkling.

Butler Fei frowned, still thinking about something, but the man had already taken steps and left as fast as he could.

Young Chaofeng remembered that he almost overestimated the purchase price, and couldn't help but breathed a sigh of relief and clasped his fists."Girl corrected me promptly, Kang Ning would like to thank you."

"Easy to say." Lu Shiyan nodded and smiled."It's just a trivial matter, not worth mentioning."
